content:
Laredo College's Palomino Pantry just got a big restock — and students fighting food insecurity are the ones who win. Longtime community partner Falcon Bank delivered a generous donation to the pantry this week, part of a regional effort that stretched from Laredo to Brownsville and McAllen.

According to Laredo College, Falcon Bank Assistant Vice President Alyssa Osorio — herself a former Palomino — said the bank is proud to give back to a college that means so much to the community, noting the donation supports students who are the future of Laredo.

A regional day of service, delivered locally

The gift came through Falcon Bank's second annual Texas Banks Community Day of Service, held in partnership with the Texas Bankers Association. On Oct. 20, the bank distributed donations collected across its branches in Laredo, Zapata, Eagle Pass, Del Rio, Stone Oak, Buda, Bandera, Brownsville and McAllen — non-perishable food, pet food, blankets and cases of water gathered in a community-wide drive.

Laredo-area recipients included the Palomino Pantry, the United Way of Laredo and Texas A&M International University's Dusty Pantry, so students and families on both sides of town get help meeting essential needs.

The pantry: food, clothes, school supplies

The Palomino Pantry was established to tackle food insecurity and basic-needs challenges faced by LC students. It stocks groceries, snacks, clothing, hygiene products and school supplies — the everyday things that keep students focused on their education instead of their next meal.

“Every donation helps us meet real needs on our campus,” said LC Director of Student Life Pedro Rivera, adding that it's encouraging to see local organizations come together to support student success.

Students who need the pantry can reach the LC Office of Student Life at studentlife@laredo.edu or (956) 721-5179. And here's the good-news headline worth saying out loud: when a local bank, a bankers' association and a community college all pull in the same direction, Laredo students eat better — and nobody has to wonder where their next meal is coming from.

title: Falcon Bank donation restocks Laredo College's Palomino Pantry
